objective: T-20260929-60: data acceptance (not a strategy backtest) of the free DoltHub post-no-preference/options database for pricing option strategies -- coverage of SPY/QQQ/AAPL/NVDA/TSLA vs the SIP daily sessions, snapshot time-of-day (put-call parity vs SIP close/open), relative spreads, bad quotes -- against thresholds written into results.json before the first data request. A pass unlocks T-61/62/63; otherwise T-64 (paid data) goes to the owner.
existing_solution_comparison: Alpaca free-tier options (dir:alpaca_free_options_iv_signals) has no historical quotes (trade-derived IV covers 31-39% and has the opposite sign), so it cannot price spreads. Kaggle SPY and OptionsDX stop in 2023 and Cboe gives index level only (David Arias 2026-08). DoltHub is the only free source with single-name bid/ask chains to 2026-09; paid vendors (OptionMetrics, CBOE DataShop, ORATS) are not evaluated because paying is an owner decision (T-64). Checked `oc research directions check dolthub` and `options`: the only prior local mention is docs/answers-friday-plan-questions-2026-09-15.zh.md, which records the source as unconfirmed.
target_regime_and_horizon: Data window 2019-02-09 to 2026-09-28; recent-regime window 2024-01-02 onward; daily EOD chains, near-month (about 0-6 weeks) only.
remaining_evidence_gap: Quote provenance, snapshot time and license are undocumented on every page read; the acceptance run measures the snapshot time indirectly through put-call parity against SIP close/open. Only a sample of chain days can be pulled in the task window because the API latency is 30-60 s per request (measured), so chain-level tests are on a seeded random sample of days and coverage/quote-hygiene counts are exact from server-side aggregates.
negative_experiments_checked: No local experiment has used DoltHub. The gap-search agent's own probe (gap-search-2026-09-29-16.md) already reported that AAPL had only about 73% of 2024 sessions in volatility_history and that each symbol-day has only 130-190 contracts and at most ~6 weeks of expiries: these are the expected failure modes and are what the criteria test.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: No trading. For downstream tasks: sell at bid / buy at ask plus $0.65 per contract (unverified), signal day d information = close of d unless parity shows a later snapshot.

queries.query: free historical options data end-of-day bid ask quotes SPY chain 2024 2025
dolthub post-no-preference options SQL API option_chain volatility_history

sources.claim: David Arias (2026-08, checked against live sources 8 Aug 2026) lists DoltHub post-no-preference/options as covering 2,321 US symbols from 2019 to yesterday with greeks/IV, no account, and says the whole-market bulk pull needs the dolt CLI (tens of gigabytes).
sources.market_and_period: US equity/ETF option chains, 2019 to 2026-08, EOD.
sources.applicability: Confirms the source exists, is free and has single-name bid/ask chains; says nothing about coverage gaps, snapshot time or spread quality.
sources.limitations: Secondary blog; does not audit data quality; the 2,321-symbol count is about symbols, not per-day completeness.
sources.independent_replication: None yet: T-20260929-60 is the local acceptance test of these claims; the earlier local Alpaca free-tier test (dir:alpaca_free_options_iv_signals) had no historical quotes at all.

sources.claim: The public DoltHub SQL API of post-no-preference/options answers without a key and exposes exactly two tables, option_chain and volatility_history.
sources.applicability: Direct evidence that the free SQL API is reachable from this machine and which tables exist.
sources.limitations: Says nothing about quote provenance, snapshot time, license or completeness.
sources.independent_replication: None yet: T-20260929-60 is the local acceptance test of these claims; the earlier local Alpaca free-tier test (dir:alpaca_free_options_iv_signals) had no historical quotes at all.

stop_condition: Verdict per the preregistered rule in results.json: pass = all five acceptance symbols meet every criterion; partial = allowed list is the symbols meeting every criterion; fail = none; incomplete = acceptance chains not fully pulled in 90 minutes. No threshold is changed after data is seen.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Server-side per-(date,symbol) aggregates over all US sessions 2019-02-09..2026-09-28 for the five symbols (exact coverage and quote hygiene) plus a seeded random sample of full-chain days for parity and spread.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: All four preregistered criteria hold for the five acceptance symbols (coverage >=85%/90%, parity deviation <=0.10%, ATM spread <=3% SPY/QQQ and <=10% single names, bad quotes <=2%).
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: Coverage of any acceptance symbol below 85% since 2019 or below 90% since 2024 already fails that symbol; parity, spread or bad-quote breaches fail it likewise.
